methodologyNotes: Roster covers 13 high-search label maker and label printer models spanning handheld tape-based units (Brother P-touch, Dymo LabelManager, Epson LabelWorks) and roll-based portable/desktop thermal printers (Niimbot, Phomemo, Dymo LabelWriter, Brother QL). Specs were re-verified against manufacturer product pages (brother-usa.com, dymo.com, phomemo.com, epson.com, niimbots.com), authorized reseller spec sheets (ptouchdirect.com, staples.com, cdw.com, demco.com, grandandtoy.com), and PR Newswire press releases. Prices reflect published US MSRP or current widely-listed retail price where no separate MSRP exists; where no published US price could be confirmed (discontinued models), priceUsd is null. print_resolution_dpi is numeric (dots per inch); max_label_width_mm is numeric millimeters; connectivity is a slash-delimited string of confirmed interfaces; built_in_keyboard is boolean; label_format distinguishes laminated-tape cassette designs ('tape') from roll-based die-cut/continuous media ('roll' / 'die_cut'). Corrections this pass: Epson LW-400 price nulled (discontinued, no confirmable new US price); Niimbot D110 and Phomemo M110 reclassified tape->roll (both use thermal label rolls, not cassettes); QL-1110NWB priceNote corrected to Best Buy direct. All 13 products confirmed to exist; none removed. accessedAt 2026-06-20.

products.name: Brother P-touch PT-D210
products.provenance: Price $65.95 per ptouchdirect.com (Walmart lists ~$69.99). Resolution 180 dpi, max TZe tape width 12 mm (1/2 in), and 6-AAA battery power confirmed via Walmart spec and Brother USA product page. No USB/wireless interface; standalone with built-in QWERTY keyboard. Release year not published; left null.

products.name: Brother P-touch PT-D410
products.provenance: MSRP $104.99 from ptouchdirect.com. Release 2022 confirmed by Brother USA brochure (Aug 2022) and Brother product page. USB-only connectivity (P-touch Editor unlock via included USB cable), max TZe tape 18 mm (3/4 in), 180 dpi confirmed across Brother and Amazon listings. Built-in keyboard, AC adapter included.

products.name: Brother P-touch PT-D610BT
products.provenance: MSRP $174.99 per ptouchdirect.com; retail spread ~$115 (instant savings) to ~$184. Standalone resolution 180 dpi (180x360 dpi when printing from PC), max TZe tape 24 mm (~1 in), USB + Bluetooth confirmed on Brother and CDW spec sheets. Built-in QWERTY keyboard and full-color LCD confirmed.

products.name: Brother P-touch CUBE Plus PT-P710BT
products.provenance: MSRP $174.99 confirmed on ptouchdirect.com (current sale $124.98; some retailers ~$99-115). Release 2019 inferred from Brother USA brochure (Apr 2019). No built-in keyboard (Keyboard: N/A on ptouchdirect spec; app/PC-driven via Bluetooth/USB). Max tape 24 mm, 180 dpi (180x360 from PC), built-in Li-ion battery confirmed.

products.name: Dymo LabelManager 160
products.provenance: Price $44.99 at Staples (Walmart observed ~$29.83). Resolution 180 dpi, max D1 tape width 12 mm (1/2 in; also takes 6/9 mm), 6-AAA or optional AC power, and built-in QWERTY keyboard confirmed via Dymo and retailer spec sheets. No PC connectivity.

products.name: Dymo LabelManager 280
products.provenance: MSRP $148.99 from ptouchdirect.com; Staples current price $93.80. Resolution 180 dpi confirmed by Staples spec sheet and independent review (ptouchdirect's '300 dpi' marketing claim is contradicted by Dymo documentation and most sources, so 180 dpi retained). Max D1 tape 12 mm (1/2 in), USB connectivity, rechargeable Li-ion battery, QWERTY keyboard confirmed. Release year 2013.

products.name: Dymo LabelWriter 550
products.priceNote: Widely-listed retail (~$147 Staples to ~$229 Demco; commonly ~$199)
products.provenance: Release Oct 1, 2021 confirmed via DYMO/Newell PR Newswire press release. Price varies widely ($146.80 Staples, $229 Demco); $199 retained as a representative widely-listed price. Print resolution 300 dpi and max print/media width 56 mm (2.2 in; accepts up to ~2.3 in labels) confirmed via Grand & Toy and CDW spec sheets. USB-only connectivity, AC power, no keyboard (computer-driven).

products.name: Brother QL-800
products.provenance: Price $124.99 confirmed on Staples product page (ptouchdirect MSRP $189.99). Resolution 300 dpi standard (up to 300x600 dpi superfine), max DK label width 62 mm (2.4 in) confirmed across Brother, Amazon and CDW listings. Black + red printing (DK-22251). USB-only, AC power, no built-in keyboard. Supports DK die-cut and continuous roll labels.

products.name: Brother QL-1110NWB
products.priceNote: Current retail at Best Buy (ptouchdirect MSRP $504.99)
products.provenance: MSRP $504.99 per ptouchdirect.com; Best Buy lists $377.99 directly (priceNote corrected from prior 'sold via Newegg Official', which was inaccurate). Max DK label width 104 mm (4.09 in) and 300x300 dpi resolution confirmed on Brother spec page, ptouchdirect and Staples. Bluetooth, Wi-Fi 802.11b/g/n, Ethernet and USB all confirmed. AC powered, no built-in keyboard or display.

products.name: Epson LabelWorks LW-400
products.priceNote: Discontinued; no confirmable published new US price (only renewed/open-box ~$59-63)
products.provenance: priceUsd set to null: the LW-400 is discontinued, the Epson US product page lists no price, and the previously-claimed '$49 sale / $59 regular at labelworks.epson.com' could not be corroborated (the LW-400 is not hosted on labelworks.epson.com). Only renewed/open-box listings (~$59-63) exist, which are not a published new US price. Max tape 18 mm (3/4 in; also 6/9/12 mm), 180 dpi, 6-AA power, and QWERTY keyboard with backlit LCD confirmed on Epson US page. No PC connectivity (standalone).

products.name: Niimbot D110
products.priceNote: Listed price on niimbots.com (sale ~$18.99) and Amazon
products.provenance: Price $18.99-$19.99 confirmed on niimbots.com (regular $29.99). Resolution 203 dpi, max label width 15 mm, Bluetooth connectivity, and built-in 1500 mAh Li-ion battery all confirmed on niimbots.com. label_format corrected tape->roll: D110 uses die-cut/continuous thermal label rolls (e.g. 12x40, 14x30, 15x30 mm), not laminated cassette tape. Original D110 released 2021 (an 'upgraded' revision shipped 2024). No built-in keyboard; NIIMBOT app-controlled.

products.name: Phomemo M110
products.provenance: Price $51.99 confirmed on phomemo.com (MSRP $96). Resolution 203 dpi, label width range 20-50 mm (max 50 mm), Bluetooth 4.0 + Micro USB connectivity, and built-in 1200 mAh Li-ion battery all confirmed on phomemo.com product page and label-maker information chart. label_format corrected tape->roll: M110 uses thermal label rolls (die-cut/continuous), not cassette tape. No built-in keyboard; app/PC-driven.
